title: Media Resources | CDC Newsroom
content: Media Resources Mar. 26, 2024 What to know CDC b-roll is produced by the United States Government and is in the public domain. This means that the footage is meant for public use and is not subject to copyright law protections. Permission is not required for use of public domain items. However, we do ask that you cite CDC as the source. Overview Tip To download any video file, right click on the video link and select "Save target as". For images, visit the Public Health Image Library (PHIL) . We also recommend the National Library of Medicine image library.
